summary.result: The high values fur water use efficiency and uniformity indicate that subsurface drip irrigation can be a sustainable method for conserving irrigation water.
summary.background: The primary objective of this study was to compare water use efficiencies between subsurface drip irrigation and furrow irrigation.
summary.method: Significantly less water was applied with subsurface drip irrigation than with furrow irrigation (29.5 % less for cantaloupe and 43.2 % less for bell poppet) in order to produce similar crop yields.
